description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 , ne Yzberisht , prane Big Market .
Organizohet ne ambient gatimi , sallon i bollshem , 2 dhoma gjumi , ballkon , tualet dhe korridor.
Ndodhet ne katin e 8 te fundit ne pallat me ashensor .
Me siperfaqe 79.5 m2 bruto dhe 70.5 m2 neto .
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Cmimi shitjes eshte 12.500.000 Leke.
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale, in Yzberisht, near Big Market. It is organized in a kitchen area, spacious living room, 2 bedrooms, balcony, toilet and corridor. It is located on the last 8th floor of the building with an elevator. With an area of ​​79.5 m2 gross and 70.5 m2 net. Has regular mortgage documentation. The selling price is 12,500,000 Lek.
